mentions.name: Access Grid
mentions.description: This platform issues and manages secure NFC credentials for Apple and Google Wallet via an API, with no app required. It simplifies issuing MIFARE DESFire-enabled NFC credentials, providing SDKs in major languages (Python, Ruby, C#, JavaScript, etc.) and a developer console with request logs.
mentions.problem: Issuing MIFARE DESFire-enabled NFC credentials is complex; the platform removes that complexity and makes it developer friendly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.accessgrid.com/ - The best way to issue and manage secure NFC credentials for Apple and Google Wallet via API.

No app required!

We took all of the complexity of issuing MIFARE DESFire enabled NFC credentials and made it extremely developer friendly. SDKs in most major languages (python, ruby, csharp, js, etc), developer console with request logs, and more.
